title: Install klinecharts and define stock chart type definitions
description: Install the klinecharts npm package and create TypeScript type definitions for the stock chart feature, including API request/response types and chart configuration types.

files.change: Create type definitions for stock chart API response, K-line data points, period types, and indicator toggle state

implementation: Run `npm install klinecharts` in apps/dsa-web to add the klinecharts library (~40KB gzipped, zero deps)

Create apps/dsa-web/src/types/stockChart.ts with types: StockChartKlineItem (date, open, high, low, close, volume, amount), StockChartPeriod ('daily'|'weekly'|'monthly'), StockChartIndicator ('macd'|'kdj'|'boll'|'vol'), StockChartResponse (code, name, period, data: StockChartKlineItem[]), and StockChartParams (code, period, startDate, endDate)
Verify types match the backend API contract: GET /api/v1/stock-chart/{code} with camelCase transform via existing Axios interceptor

reference.examples: Follow the interface definition pattern in strategyBacktest.ts with JSDoc comments

criteria: stockChart.ts exports at least 4 type/interfaces: StockChartKlineItem, StockChartPeriod, StockChartIndicator, StockChartResponse
TypeScript compilation passes with no errors
